response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s AS (SELECT t, c, c * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.c) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
